channel.title: Daily Thanthi Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: IndiGo cancels around 180 flights from Bengaluru, Hyderabad on Tuesday; likely to lose some routes
item.description: The Rahul Bhatia-controlled airline operates over 2,200 flights per day from 90-odd domestic destinations and 40-plus abroad destinations.

item.title: Kerala local body polls: Voting begins in key Kerala local body elections, polling close to 15 pc after 2 hours
item.description: Voters of all ages and professions, including actors like Asif Ali and Renji Panicker, were seen standing in queues since early morning to exercise their franchise

item.title: TVK Puducherry meet LIVE: Vijay to address first public meet since Karur tragedy
item.description: To manage the crowd and ensure safety, authorities and organisers have put in place extensive arrangements, issued guidelines for volunteers, and declared school closures around the venue as a precaution.

item.title: I thought Aishwarya Rai was correct for the role of Neelambari in 'Padayappa', says Rajinikanth
item.description: The actor also disclosed that when they had to look for another person for the role, he had pointed out to director Ravikumar that if this film had to work, the role of Neelambari had to be powerful.

item.title: Asian shares slip after Wall Street pulls back from its record heights
item.description: Tokyo's Nikkei 225 index was the main outlier, gaining 0.2 per cent to 50,691.39

item.title: Wishes pour in as Sonia Gandhi turns 79
item.description: Gandhi, who is the Congress Parliamentary Party chairperson, turned 79 on Tuesday.

item.title: Bangladesh: Awami League flags alarming human rights abuses under the Yunus-led interim government
item.description: The party questioned what it means for a country’s future if dozens can be killed in one month, several detained for Facebook posts, and hundreds terrorised in raids

item.title: Release of Vignesh Shivan's 'LIK' postponed again?
item.description: Rumours doing the rounds suggest that the makers are now looking to release the film during the Valentine's Day weekend

item.title: After court's acquittal in Kerala actress assault case, Dileep mulls legal action
item.description: In a strong reaction after the judgment, Dileep said he would seek a probe into what he described as a “conspiracy” behind his implication in the case.

item.title: Gold, silver open flat ahead of the US Fed policy outcome
item.description: On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), gold February contracts were unchanged at Rs 1,29,978 per 10 grams during early trade
